title: Arkansas 2125 – Beta 0.6 adds new locations, quests and more
author: No_Piano_1857
selftext:
Beta 0.6 is now available!

This update adds two new locations, including a new strip club west of Pinehill and an abandoned campsite in Ouachita National Forest. There are also new dialogue options and a new quest for Colby in Clearwater.

Other additions include marijuana plants beneath FoodMart, a candy dealer in Silverton, new effects for candies, lockpicks in the scavenger camp, road signs, and Multishot for enemies using submachine guns.

I've also included a map showing the locations of the new areas.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/4546490/Arkansas\_2125/

The game is currently 25% off until September 23.
